task.title: A run fails before it finishes
task.shortdesc: The run shows as failed with an error, and no report.

context.p: Cause: A setting the job can't use, such as an unknown mode, a map outside the corpus, or a missing or malformed Gemini key for a live run. Key values are never shown in errors.

step.cmd: Open the run and read its error.
For a key error, add a new version of the gemini-api-key secret and start the run again.
